snippet.title: Outcity | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Outcity now on Steam:  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3638080/Outcity/ 

Discover a cozy farm-building sandbox where players shape a homestead from wild land, automate tasks through helpful villagers, explore unique biomes, and uncover rare treasures in endless underground caves.

🌱 Build creatively with total freedom
👩‍🌾 Automate chores with friendly NPC helpers
🗺️ Explore diverse regions with unique crops
⛏️ Discover rare resources in vast cave networks
✨ Grow through deep upgrade progression
